method: repository-wide grep for literal CAPTURED sensor-status producers and gnss_agreement claims, in *.py, at the 20261021 sweep checkpoint

findings.reason: Not a live evidence producer. make_valid_bundle() builds a synthetic all-PASS bundle specifically so run_negative_controls() can assert the governed certifier engine REJECTS fabrications (NEGATIVE_CASES includes empty_sensor_marked_pass -> EMPTY_SENSOR_EVIDENCE_MARKED_PASS, zero_fps_marked_pass -> ZERO_FPS_MARKED_PASS, zero_vehicle_spawns_marked_pass, manually_edited_pass_json). This code is the anti-fabrication tripwire itself; mutating it would weaken certification, not clean it.

Consumer logic that requires status==CAPTURED AND frame_non_empty before counting sensor evidence against a bundle. It hardens against empty-sensor bundles; keeping it is fail-safe. The phase-L producer no longer emits CAPTURED for unexecuted rigs (retired to NOT_RUN_NO_SENSOR_RIG), so the guard only ever fires on genuinely captured frames or on legacy bundles, which are retired separately in RETIRED_FALSE_PASS.json.

Read-only analysis script that summarizes the retired, immutable historical artifacts (reports/post_audit_hardening/L9 runs). It produces no status values itself. Its output must be cited together with RETIRED_FALSE_PASS.json, which revokes the evidentiary status of those artifacts.

Post-rewrite field: gnss_agreement is explicitly None with sensor status NOT_RUN_NO_SENSOR_RIG when no sensor rig ran. Verified by tests/unit/test_phase_l_fail_closed.py::test_l9_no_sensor_rig_must_not_be_pass.
The regression test asserting CAPTURED can no longer appear without an executed rig.

retired_artifacts_note: The five fabricated L9_sensor_validation.json artifacts are not materialized in this sparse worktree; they are hash-pinned in reports/EVIDENCE_INDEX.json and revoked in reports/p0_remediation_20261021/RETIRED_FALSE_PASS.json without any file mutation (historical artifacts immutable).
conclusion: No live producer of fabricated sensor evidence remains outside retired historical artifacts and the intentional certifier negative-control fixtures.
governance_note: phase_q make_valid_bundle/apply_negative are test scaffolding for run_negative_controls(); they must NOT be removed or weakened. Recorded here so future audits do not re-flag them as fabrication.
